properties.description: Incremental-aware SCD2 processing with control.PipelineRunDetail timing and row metrics. RowsRead = staging.Silver_Wells delta rows. RowsWritten = actual gold.Dim_Well SCD2 rows updated/inserted (not total Gold snapshot rows). SCD2 Script failures are logged by the child to ADF_Pipeline_Log after PipelineRunDetail logging and before explicit child Fail. FINAL V2: preserves SCD2 SQL/metrics and routes operational failure persistence through common handler.

scripts.text:
DECLARE @BatchDate DATE = CAST(SYSUTCDATETIME() AS DATE);
DECLARE @RowsRead BIGINT = (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM staging.Silver_Wells);
DECLARE @DimWellRowsWritten BIGINT = 0;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. DIM_OPERATOR - SCD TYPE 2 FROM CURRENT DELTA
------------------------------------------------------------
UPDATE t
SET t.[Is_Current] = 0,
    t.Effective_To = @BatchDate,
    t.Updated_At = SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM gold.Dim_Operator AS t
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT OperatorCode, LicenseeCode
    FROM staging.Silver_Wells
    WHERE OperatorCode IS NOT NULL AND OperatorCode <> ''
) AS s
  ON t.OperatorCode = s.OperatorCode
 AND t.[Is_Current] = 1
WHERE ISNULL(t.LicenseeCode,'') <> ISNULL(s.LicenseeCode,'');

INSERT INTO gold.Dim_Operator
(OperatorCode, LicenseeCode, Effective_From, Effective_To, [Is_Current])
SELECT DISTINCT s.OperatorCode, s.LicenseeCode, @BatchDate, '9999-12-31', 1
FROM staging.Silver_Wells AS s
WHERE s.OperatorCode IS NOT NULL
  AND s.OperatorCode <> ''
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM gold.Dim_Operator AS d
      WHERE d.OperatorCode = s.OperatorCode
        AND ISNULL(d.LicenseeCode,'') = ISNULL(s.LicenseeCode,'')
        AND d.[Is_Current] = 1
  );

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. DIM_WELL - SCD TYPE 2 FROM CURRENT DELTA
------------------------------------------------------------
UPDATE t
SET t.[Is_Current] = 0,
    t.Effective_To = @BatchDate,
    t.Updated_At = SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM gold.Dim_Well AS t
INNER JOIN staging.Silver_Wells AS s
  ON t.WellID = s.WellID
 AND t.[Is_Current] = 1
WHERE ISNULL(t.WellName,'') <> ISNULL(s.WellName,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.FieldCode,'') <> ISNULL(s.FieldCode,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.LicenseeCode,'') <> ISNULL(s.LicenseeCode,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.OperatorCode,'') <> ISNULL(s.OperatorCode,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.LicenceStatus,'') <> ISNULL(s.LicenceStatus,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.WellTotalDepth,-1) <> ISNULL(s.WellTotalDepth,-1)
   OR ISNULL(t.WellStatCode,'') <> ISNULL(s.WellStatCode,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.FluidDesc,'') <> ISNULL(s.FluidDesc,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.ModeDesc,'') <> ISNULL(s.ModeDesc,'');
SET @DimWellRowsWritten += @@ROWCOUNT;

INSERT INTO gold.Dim_Well
(WellID, WellName, FieldCode, LicenseeCode, OperatorCode, LicenceStatus,
 WellTotalDepth, WellStatCode, FluidDesc, ModeDesc,
 Effective_From, Effective_To, [Is_Current])
SELECT s.WellID, s.WellName, s.FieldCode, s.LicenseeCode, s.OperatorCode,
       s.LicenceStatus, s.WellTotalDepth, s.WellStatCode, s.FluidDesc, s.ModeDesc,
       @BatchDate, '9999-12-31', 1
FROM staging.Silver_Wells AS s
WHERE s.WellID IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM gold.Dim_Well AS d
      WHERE d.WellID = s.WellID AND d.[Is_Current] = 1
  );
SET @DimWellRowsWritten += @@ROWCOUNT;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. DIM_LICENCESTATUS - NEW DELTA VALUES ONLY
------------------------------------------------------------
MERGE gold.Dim_LicenceStatus AS t
USING (
    SELECT DISTINCT LicenceStatus
    FROM staging.Silver_Wells
    WHERE LicenceStatus IS NOT NULL
) AS s
ON t.LicenceStatus = s.LicenceStatus
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (LicenceStatus) VALUES (s.LicenceStatus);

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. DIM_WELLTYPE - NEW DELTA COMBINATIONS ONLY
------------------------------------------------------------
MERGE gold.Dim_WellType AS t
USING (
    SELECT DISTINCT FluidDesc, ModeDesc, TypeDesc, StructureDesc
    FROM staging.Silver_Wells
) AS s
ON  ISNULL(t.FluidDesc,'') = ISNULL(s.FluidDesc,'')
AND ISNULL(t.ModeDesc,'') = ISNULL(s.ModeDesc,'')
AND ISNULL(t.TypeDesc,'') = ISNULL(s.TypeDesc,'')
AND ISNULL(t.StructureDesc,'') = ISNULL(s.StructureDesc,'')
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (FluidDesc, ModeDesc, TypeDesc, StructureDesc)
VALUES (s.FluidDesc, s.ModeDesc, s.TypeDesc, s.StructureDesc);

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. FACT_OILPRICE - EXISTING UPSERT
------------------------------------------------------------
MERGE gold.Fact_OilPrice AS t
USING (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(period AS DATE) AS PriceDate,
           TRY_CAST(value AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OilPrice_USD,
           [series-description] AS SeriesDescription
    FROM staging.OilPrice
    WHERE period IS NOT NULL AND value IS NOT NULL
) AS s
ON t.PriceDate = s.PriceDate
WHEN MATCHED AND ISNULL(t.OilPrice_USD,-1) <> ISNULL(s.OilPrice_USD,-1)
THEN UPDATE SET t.OilPrice_USD = s.OilPrice_USD, t.Updated_At = SYSUTCDATETIME()
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (PriceDate, OilPrice_USD, SeriesDescription, Created_At, Updated_At)
VALUES (s.PriceDate, s.OilPrice_USD, s.SeriesDescription, SYSUTCDATETIME(), SYSUTCDATETIME());

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. FACT_WELLSNAPSHOT - FULL DAILY SNAPSHOT FROM GOLD CURRENT STATE
------------------------------------------------------------
DELETE FROM gold.Fact_WellSnapshot WHERE SnapshotDate = @BatchDate;

INSERT INTO gold.Fact_WellSnapshot
(SnapshotDate, WellID, OperatorCode, LicenceStatus, FluidDesc, ModeDesc, FieldCode, WellTotalDepth)
SELECT @BatchDate, WellID, OperatorCode, LicenceStatus, FluidDesc, ModeDesc, FieldCode, WellTotalDepth
FROM gold.Dim_Well
WHERE [Is_Current] = 1;

SELECT @RowsRead AS RowsRead, @DimWellRowsWritten AS RowsWritten;
